key_reasoning.reason: Diffstat reports 7 files (L under the actual-mode 7-10 mapping): 3 source files (Popup, UnifiedBudgetDragBar, UnifiedProjectBudgetModal) plus 4 test files, one of them new (UnifiedProjectBudgetModal.busy.test). Most of the 661 insertions are tests. The files sit in 2 directory trees: src/components/Popup and src/pages/settings/administration/components.

Three components in one UI tier: the shared Popup dialog gains opt-in busy/busyHint props, the drag bar gains a disabled prop, and the budget modal wires both and wraps its form in a disabled fieldset. Popup is a shared dialog used by every dialog in the app, so the shared-utility red flag was considered. The change is opt-in and its defaults keep existing behaviour. The total sits on the 14/15 boundary, Technical Risk is M and existing patterns cover most of the work, so the lean-lower rule applies and the bump was not taken.

The patterns are established: a disabled prop, a fieldset lock, and a ref guard against double submit that already existed. Some parts are new for this dialog: one hide guard covering Cancel, the close icon, Escape and the backdrop; moving focus to the dialog content when the submit button becomes disabled; and a delayed aria-live busy hint that stays mounted. These are accessibility and behaviour concerns with no security or performance impact, and rollback is trivial.
The ticket is concrete: lock the dialog while a save is in flight, and it names the three prop-level changes. No open design decisions are visible in the diff.
